name: luna-review-loop
description: A safe Codex implementation and ChatGPT review loop for Codex Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: A safe Codex and ChatGPT development loop.
interface.longDescription: Runs a simple, recoverable handoff between one Codex implementation task and one active, bounded ChatGPT web conversation at a time. A reviewer Chat rolls over before its third formal review or after any real rate limit, while clear replies continue the original task once.
defaultPrompt: Start a SuperLuna development and web Chat review loop.
